assets.label: 书本与文档组件
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW sheet of isolated reusable OBJECT COMPONENT ART for a pixel-style explainer video. The supplied workshop is ONLY the art-style reference, NOT a background or scene to reproduce. Output a landscape sheet on genuine transparent alpha background, with THREE well-separated objects in one horizontal row, generous clear margins, no overlaps. No room, table, floor, backdrop, diorama, support platform, interface panels, frames, labels, words or numbers. Extract the reference's visual characteristics: precise hard-edged square pixel clusters, dark navy stepped silhouettes, blue-petrol shadows, small warm amber highlights, tactile but SIMPLIFIED materials, compact game-prop proportions. The props must look like movable assets painted by the same artist who painted the small tools, drawers, crates and equipment in that workshop. Work as if EACH object has roughly 80–110 logical pixels across, then enlarge cleanly: clearly deliberate pixel construction, 3–5 broad shade bands per material, selective single-pixel highlights. NO photorealism, smooth 3D, smooth gradients, fuzzy textured painting, paper-fiber photography, dense fine dithering, artificial mosaic filter, excessive detail, neon outlines or magical effects. Match the reference's subtle warm upper-left light and subdued cyan ambient fill, do not make the whole asset glowing gold. Show the complete silhouette and thickness from a coherent slightly elevated 3/4 front view. Small attached shadows inside object relationships are allowed, but no large cast floor shadow or dark background halo. These are ART REFERENCES only, not a state-machine diagram. Three components: LEFT a closed teal cloth hardback with dark navy spine, small worn brass corners and muted brick-red ribbon; CENTER the SAME book open, readable page block, muted warm-ivory pages with a few short understated pixel strokes suggesting content but NO actual writing, continuous spine and connected covers; RIGHT a compact slightly uneven stack of ivory documents with a dark brass clip and one muted teal divider. Favor bold understandable forms like the workshop assets; book page edges should use sparse thick pixel steps, not hundreds of tiny photographic layers. The three remain independent object assets rather than thumbnails in cards. Teal fabric, paper, brass and their shadows should all share the workshop's pixel density and material language.
